meta.name: tavily
meta.description: Tavily web search, content extraction, and research tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取内容用于研究
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从互联网获取结构化信息进行分析。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract content for research.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to gather structured information from the internet for analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能使用 Tavily 工具进行网络搜索和内容提取。它会根据你的需求选择快速搜索、带高级选项的搜索（如设置时间范围、域名过滤、AI 总结等），或从指定网址提取内容，支持 JavaScript 渲染页面并返回干净的 Markdown。
howto.when: 当你需要快速查找信息、限定搜索范围或时效，或需要从特定网页获取完整内容时，Claude 会调用相应工具。

say.text: 搜索最近一周关于AI的新闻。
帮我提取这三个网址的内容：url1, url2, url3
用高级深度搜索量子计算的最新进展。

howto.what_en: Claude can use Tavily tools to search the web and extract content. It performs quick searches, advanced searches with options like time range or domain filters, or extracts content from specified URLs, handling JavaScript-rendered pages and returning clean Markdown.
howto.when_en: When you need quick info, want to filter search by time or domain, or need full content from specific URLs, Claude will invoke the appropriate tool.

say_en.text: Search for recent AI news from the past week.
say_en.note: Claude uses tavily_search with time_range set to week.

say_en.text: Extract content from these three URLs: url1, url2, url3
say_en.note: Claude calls tavily_extract for the given URLs.

say_en.text: Deep search quantum computing latest with advanced depth.
say_en.note: Claude uses tavily_search with advanced depth.
